record.reason: The system retrieves cached video-context representations for streaming VideoQA and reports improved efficiency against VideoQA baselines. It is a modality-specific KV retrieval method; evidence does not establish applicability to text-only LLM KV caches.
record.title: Streaming Video Question-Answering with In-context Video KV-Cache Retrieval
